results.title: Redditor Wonders if She Was Wrong for Not Inviting Her Sister on a Girls Trip After Years of Feeling Unsupported by Her: ‘Why Would I?’
results.description: A woman on Reddit had her first child when she was 18. It wasn’t easy, but she married her high school sweetheart and made it work. Her sister, however, was never supportive. When her daughter traveled for a volleyball tournament, she invited her mom to join her on the trip but didn’t invite her sister.… Sign up to receive the Daily Dot’s Internet Insider newsletter for urgent news from the frontline of online.
